description: Which validators must have run for a promotion candidate, ADR-113 decision 3. A validator absent from this table is never consulted by the promotion gate, so every required status check on the default branch ruleset has a row here and a test fails on drift. Each row names the workflow file whose run holds its job, which the provenance check requires. Build-tier rows also bind to the npm tarball digest. Issue 5636.
